packageRules.description: PHPUnit 10+ requires PHP 8.1+ (13 requires 8.4); this package targets PHP 8.0 via config.platform.php
wordpress-stubs 7 is unresolvable while the latest wp-cli-stubs release (v2.12.0) caps it at ^6.0; upstream widened the range but has not tagged since
PHPCS 4 needs WPCS 4.0, which is unreleased (latest stable WPCS 3.4.1 requires PHPCS ^3.13.5)
